interpretation: Status applies only to evidence method and scope, never implies live availability; Partial maps to unknown with source label retained.
invalidation: Connection/credential identity or revision, organization/project scope, endpoint/base path, transport API, model identifier or serving revision changes invalidate dependent live evidence.
Documentation/schema/SDK/OpenAI dependency revision changes require re-review and fixtures.
Lifecycle/redirect notices, permissions/quota changes, inconsistent discovery or malformed streams stale affected observations.
Historical snapshots remain historical. TTL alone is not proof of validity.
Provider can redirect retired model strings: same identifier does not guarantee same weights.
